# UPDATE (22 Oct 2026, correction pass): 14 files were added from the correction pass's run of phase4d.spec.ts on the final source (step4d_correction_e2e_playwright.txt): the 10 files listed above as missing (01, 02, 03, 08 and 19, both widths), regenerated now, and 21-unresolved-after-dismiss and 22-admin-replan-before-the-view-loaded (both widths), new.
